methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.skip_reason: insufficient narrow peer set in Robotics & Manufacturing (found 0 same-stage, 1 adjacent-stage, 0 similar-tier; need ≥3)
methods.rationale: 11 same-sector peers exist in Robotics & Manufacturing, but none of the narrow filters (same-stage / adjacent-stage / similar-valuation-tier) yielded ≥3 datapoints. Falling back to all-sector median would be misleading.

data.narrative:
Blitzpanel is a pre-seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company founded by Caleb Ho. The valuation exercise draws on a comp universe of 9 total peers: 1 public company (ticker 277810.KQ) and 8 private firms including Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, Generalist AI, and Bedrock Robotics.

Standard peer-median valuation methodology is not applicable here. The robotics and manufacturing sector contains 11 same-sector peers overall, but filtering by stage, timing proximity, and valuation tier yields fewer than three comparable datapoints—the minimum threshold for robust triangulation. A broad all-sector median would introduce material noise and misalign incentive structures across different business models and capital requirements.

Given the methodological constraints, a defensible valuation for Blitzpanel cannot be derived from the available data. Proceeding would require either: (1) expansion of the comp set to include earlier-stage rounds or adjacent subsectors with documented economics; (2) bottom-up build from unit economics and capital efficiency if operational milestones are disclosed; or (3) deferral until post-seed funding rounds provide market-tested pricing signals. The primary uncertainty remains the absence of sufficient narrow-band comparables at the pre-seed stage in this sector.
